title: web: a.download=att.filename assigns peer-supplied filename without stripping path separators
description: app.js:138 assigns att.filename directly to a.download, which suggests a save-as filename to the browser. A peer-supplied filename containing '../../etc/passwd' or similar path separators would be passed as-is. While browsers typically strip paths in save-as dialogs, this is browser-dependent and not spec-guaranteed. Fix: sanitize before assignment: a.download = att.filename.replace(/[\/\\]/g, '_').replace(/\0/g, '');
